title: Novel Benzimidazole-Thiazolidine-2,4-dione Hybrid Compounds as Promising PPAR-gamma Modulators with Antidiabetic Activity: Design, Synthesis, Molecular Docking, and In Vitro Evaluation.
authors: Prems, Jisha; Smith, A Anton; Prasanth, M L Lal
one_liner_zh: 该文研究苯并咪唑-噻唑烷二酮杂合化合物作为PPAR-γ调节剂的抗糖尿病活性，涉及分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Design, synthesis, and molecular docking studies of a novel series of Benzimidazole-Thiazolidine-2,4-dione hybrid compounds as PPAR-gamma modulators for antidiabetic activity. Thiazolidinediones function as agonists of PPAR-gamma, influencing the expression of numerous genes involved in the regulation of glucose, lipid, and protein metabolism. They improve insulin sensitivity by promoting glucose uptake in adipose tissue and skeletal muscle, and by reducing hepatic gluconeogenesis. OBJECTIVES: To perform the synthesis, molecular docking studies, in vitro cytotoxicity assessment, glucose uptake assay, and in vitro PPAR-gamma transcription factor assay of Benzimidazole- Thiazolidine-2,4-dione hybrid compounds as antidiabetic agents. METHODS: A molecular hybridization strategy was employed for the synthesis of Benzimidazole- Thiazolidine-2,4-dione hybrid compounds, and their chemical identities were confirmed using (1)H-NMR, (13)C-NMR, and LC-MS techniques. Molecular docking studies were conducted to analyze the binding affinities of the synthesized analogs with the target protein. The MTT assay was used to evaluate the cytotoxic effects of the new compounds, which were subsequently tested for glucose uptake using rat L6 myotubes as a model. Furthermore, the compounds underwent an in vitro PPAR-gamma transcription factor assay. RESULTS: Synthesized compounds were screened for their activation potential of PPAR-gamma expression in HepG2 cell lines, and several compounds, notably PT14 and PT18, displayed an activation potential higher than the reference standard pioglitazone. DISCUSSION: Compounds PT18 and PT14 exhibited significant PPAR-gamma expression in comparison to the commercially available PPAR-gamma agonist pioglitazone, at a concentration of 1muM which was used as the benchmark of agonist action. CONCLUSION: Compounds PT14 and PT18 are promising candidates to investigate further, as they exhibit significant cell viability, glucose uptake, and PPAR-gamma transcription factor activation in nuclear extracts. These encouraging findings warrant further exploration through in vivo pharmacokinetic and antidiabetic efficacy studies, which will help establish their therapeutic potential and safety profile in biological systems.
abstract_zh: 引言：设计、合成及分子对接研究一系列新型苯并咪唑-噻唑烷-2,4-二酮杂合化合物作为PPAR-γ调节剂用于抗糖尿病活性。噻唑烷二酮类化合物作为PPAR-γ的激动剂，影响涉及葡萄糖、脂质和蛋白质代谢调节的众多基因表达。它们通过促进脂肪组织和骨骼肌中的葡萄糖摄取，并减少肝脏糖异生，从而改善胰岛素敏感性。目的：对苯并咪唑-噻唑烷-2,4-二酮杂合化合物作为抗糖尿病药物进行合成、分子对接研究、体外细胞毒性评估、葡萄糖摄取测定及体外PPAR-γ转录因子测定。方法：采用分子杂交策略合成苯并咪唑-噻唑烷-2,4-二酮杂合化合物，并通过(1)H-NMR、(13)C-NMR和LC-MS技术确认其化学结构。进行分子对接研究以分析合成类似物与靶蛋白的结合亲和力。使用MTT测定评估新化合物的细胞毒性效应，随后以大鼠L6肌管为模型测试其葡萄糖摄取能力。此外，化合物还进行了体外PPAR-γ转录因子测定。结果：对合成化合物在HepG2细胞系中激活PPAR-γ表达的潜力进行了筛选，其中几种化合物，特别是PT14和PT18，显示出高于参考标准吡格列酮的激活潜力。讨论：在1μM浓度下（作为激动剂作用的基准），化合物PT18和PT14与市售PPAR-γ激动剂吡格列酮相比，表现出显著的PPAR-γ表达。结论：化合物PT14和PT18是有前景的进一步研究候选物，因为它们在核提取物中表现出显著的细胞活力、葡萄糖摄取和PPAR-γ转录因子激活。这些令人鼓舞的发现值得通过体内药代动力学和抗糖尿病疗效研究进一步探索，这将有助于确定其在生物系统中的治疗潜力和安全性。
